title: Executable Archaeology: Reanimating the Logic Theorist
abstract: arXiv:2611.19167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Logic Theorist (LT), created by Allen Newell, J. C. Shaw, and Herbert Simon in 1955--1956, is regarded by some as the first artificial intelligence program. It was originally simulated by hand and written in a pseudocode called the Logic Language (LL), which was later called Information Processing Language One (IPL-I). LT was revised many times. The first machine-executed version was written in IPL-II and ran on the JOHNNIAC, and a late version was published in 1963 by Einar Stefferud as a pedagogical document and written in IPL-V, the only version of IPL that was formally released to the public. We describe a reanimation of both the IPL-I (LL) version of LT and the 1963 IPL-V version. Comparing the two reanimations illuminates the process of the invention of early AI algorithms and computer languages.

translated_title: 可执行的考古学：复活逻辑理论家（Logic Theorist）
translated_abstract: 逻辑理论家（Logic Theorist，简称LT）由艾伦·纽厄尔（Allen Newell）、J. C. 肖（J. C. Shaw）和赫伯特·西蒙（Herbert Simon）于1955至1956年间创建，被一些人视为第一个人工智能程序。该程序最初通过手工模拟执行，并以一种称为逻辑语言（Logic Language，LL）的伪代码编写，这种语言后来被称为信息处理语言一号（IPL-I）。LT此后经历了多次修订：第一个在机器上实际执行的版本以IPL-II编写并运行于JOHNNIAC计算机上；1963年，Einar Stefferud以IPL-V编写并发布了一个晚期版本作为教学文档，IPL-V是唯一正式向公众发布的IPL版本。本文描述了对LT的IPL-I（LL）版本和1963年IPL-V版本的复活（即重新使其可运行）工作，通过对这两个复活版本的比较，揭示了早期人工智能算法与计算机语言的发明过程。
tldr: 本文通过“复活”（重新实现并使其可运行）逻辑理论家程序的IPL-I版本和1963年的IPL-V版本，并比较两者，从而揭示早期人工智能算法与计算机语言的发明过程。
en_tdlr: This paper reanimates both the IPL-I version of the Logic Theorist and its 1963 IPL-V version, comparing the two reconstructions to illuminate the invention of early AI algorithms and computer languages.
